Multan is one of the oldest and most historic cities in Pakistan, often called the City of Saints. In this vlog, we explore the real Multan beyond the famous shrines.
From the 2,600-year-old Multan Fort to forgotten Hindu and Jain temples, abandoned partition-era mansions, ancient streets, pottery markets, and hidden stories of families who left during the 1947 Partition, this journey uncovers a side of Multan rarely seen.
